purpose: Persist server-generated, idempotent Walking Skeleton Form submission-command receipts, their same-transaction Outbox evidence, and a reserved Task-command request metadata boundary linked by the server receipt.
lockImpact: Creates three E2E-only tables in the disposable E2E database; no production module table is altered.
dataImpact: Stores authenticated-subject/workforce/assignment references, fingerprints, exact release references, stable FileReference metadata, and safe Trace correlation only. Submitted form data and file content are never stored.
recovery: Drop task_command_requests, then form_submission_command_outbox, then form_submission_command_receipts only in the disposable E2E database after preserving required evidence.
forwardFix: Append a new globally unique migration; never edit this migration after it has been applied.
